seo.title: 4-Day Desert Tour from Agadir to Marrakech | Merzouga & Taroudant (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €395 pp. 4-day private desert tour from Agadir to Marrakech. Anti-Atlas scenic drive, Taroudant, Erg Chebbi camel trek, Sahara camp & Ait Ben Haddou.
seo.lead: This four-day overland route connects the Atlantic coast of Agadir and Taghazout to the Sahara dunes of Merzouga and finishes in Marrakech. It is an ideal option if you are wrapping up a beach stay on the coast and want to experience the desert without flying or backtracking.
seo.primaryKeyword: 4 day desert tour from Agadir to Marrakech

price.label: From EUR 395 per person
price.note: Includes private A/C transport from Agadir to Marrakech, licensed driver-guide, 2 nights in boutique riads/hotels (Dades Valley and Ouarzazate), 1 night in an Erg Chebbi desert camp, camel rides, dinners, and daily breakfasts from Day 2.

seo.imageAlt: Camel trekking in the golden dunes of Merzouga on a 4-day desert expedition from Agadir to Marrakech
highlights: Depart from Agadir or Taghazout and see the ancient ramparts of Taroudant ("Little Marrakech")
Cross the Anti-Atlas Mountains and the saffron capital of Taliouine
Walk between the 300-meter limestone canyon walls of Todra Gorges
Sunset and sunrise camel rides in the Erg Chebbi dunes of Merzouga
Overnight in a Sahara camp with Berber music, dinner, and stargazing
Visit UNESCO-listed Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou before crossing the High Atlas to Marrakech

faqs.question: Can you pick us up from our surf camp or hotel in Taghazout?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your private driver will pick you up directly from your hotel, resort, or villa in Agadir, Taghazout, or Tamraght at around 7:30 AM on Day 1.

faqs.question: Is this a practical way to travel from Agadir to Marrakech?
faqs.answer: Yes. Rather than taking a direct highway transfer or domestic flight, this route turns your transfer into a full southern Morocco road trip through Taroudant, the Anti-Atlas, the Sahara, and the High Atlas.

faqs.question: How are the road conditions between Agadir and Merzouga?
faqs.answer: The entire route follows well-maintained paved roads. Our modern air-conditioned 4x4s and minivans ensure a smooth ride across mountain passes and desert plains with regular rest stops.

faqs.question: Where do you drop us off in Marrakech?
faqs.answer: We drop you directly at your Marrakech hotel, as close as vehicles can reach to your medina riad, or at Marrakech Menara Airport (RAK) by late afternoon on Day 4.
